heading: Automatic Reach Truck
benefits: Precise storage and retrieval of goods up to 2300 kg at heights of up to 10 m thanks to pallet positioning system
For transport, incoming and outgoing goods, storage in high shelving, replenishment and supply
Flexible configuration thanks to varied selection of masts and lifting capacities
Option to choose between lead-acid and Li-ION batteries with optional quick-charge solution
Dual mode allows for manual control as needed
Easy implementation and scalability thanks to Linde MATIC:move and Linde MATIC:move+ software

items.text: 2D laser protection curtain in direction of travel for detecting objects above ground level
2D laser protection curtain on the sides for detecting objects suspended above ground level
Linde BlueSpot – visual drive path warning for pedestrians and co-workers
Red warning lights at sides – red lines projected onto floor at either side of the vehicle
Visual warnings – multicolour flashing lights indicating vehicle status
Emergency stop switches on the left/right load arms for enhanced safety in the load direction
Additional sensor (ultrasonic) for enhanced personal protection in front of load arms
2D sensors for detecting charge carriers and charge environments
Load detection (detection of pallet cages by pallet sensors at the sides)
Load detection (detection of stacked load carriers during loading)
Safety field kit 850 × 1250 mm (standard load carrier EPAL1 and pallet cage for longitudinal transport)
Safety field kit 1250 × 1250 mm (standard load carrier for longitudinal and lateral transport)
MATIC:analytics (analysis tool for optimising use and performance)

bullets: Ideal for mixed traffic thanks to extensive safety features to protect people, loads and surroundings
360° safety scanner for complete monitoring of the working environment
Visual and acoustic warning systems trigger when there are hazards
Five easy-to-reach emergency stop switches for an immediate stop
Optional warning and safety systems for additional protection
2D pallet positioning system for precise handling even when pallets are not precisely aligned
Safe storage and retrieval of different loads thanks to advanced load detection
Cantilevered fork makes handling closed load carriers on the floor easier
Compact truck masters narrow aisles from 2.95 metres
Reflector-based navigation makes it possible to precisely operate the storage and retrieval position
Highly reliable thanks to tried-and-tested technology from Linde MH
Strong service network ensures quick maintenance and repair
Easily accessible components for time-saving service
Durable, low-maintenance drive system for high availability
Digital twin supports reliable hardware and software maintenance
Individual, automated solutions with dynamic simulation and the option to run a demo in a real process environment on site
Analysis of manual handling processes and optimisation of the degree of automation as required for specific customer needs
Software solutions, such as MATIC:move and MATIC:move+ in particular, enable rapid commissioning, flexible customization, scalability, and optimal process control
